replies.body:
Hey Dokihl,

Personally, I see no problem with this. I know, for a fact, that some moderators have done worse things in the chat before than saying "ass". If they haven't been punished then I see no need for anything to happen in this situation

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

First things first, make sure that if you want to report a staff member in the future you do it through support@avicus.net so it can reach the seniors and the seniors only. Second of all, saying "ass" is an extremely, and when I say extremely I mean extremely, small event. It is not considered swearing, isn't offensive, or anything along those lines. If you had showed the rest of the chat, you would've seen people typing up sentences in Spanish, many of which included the word "años" in them. I didn't want to waste time switching my language just to type a squiggly n, so I just used a regular one. Although I don't see how this could possibly offend you or anyone else. but I guess I can kind of see why you thought it was an issue.

Regards,
President Badger


P.S. I'll leave this report open in case the seniors want to check it out.
